department: School of Mechanical and Materials Engineering
notes: Doctor of Philosophy in Mechanical Engineering.

deadline.value: January 10 priority deadline for Fall admission.

gre_general.value: Official GRE scores required for application.
gre_general.quote: Required application material includes an application, resume, statement of purpose, Student Interest Profile form, three letters of recommendation, official transcripts, official GRE scores, and official TOEFL scores (international applicants).

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no GRE Subject Test in this field.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study and help departments evaluate applicants' readiness for graduate school.

entry_route.value: Regular admission requires an earned equivalent of a 4-year U.S. bachelor's degree with a minimum 3.0 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Have earned the equivalent of a U.S. bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited institution. Typically, students should have completed a minimum of four years of study beyond grade 12.
